name: TVA Update For Woo Shop
author: Alex Tag

sections.description:
If your country decides to increase or decrease VAT, manually updating WooCommerce rates can take time.  
This plugin allows you to quickly replace an existing VAT rate with a new one, across all WooCommerce settings.

Features:
* Quick VAT update form under WooCommerce → Actualizare TVA
* Works with WooCommerce tax rates API
* Safe nonce verification and sanitization
* Example: update all products from 19% VAT to 21% VAT with one click

Jurnalul modificărilor

  • Actualizat Tested up to la 6.8.

1.0.0

  • Lansarea inițială a plugin-ului.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/tva-update-for-woo-shop/
  2. Activate the plugin through “Plugins” menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Actualizare TVA
  4. Enter the old VAT and new VAT
  5. Click “Actualizează TVA”

short_description: Easily update WooCommerce VAT tax rates when your country changes the VAT (e.g. from 19% to 21%).
